ModMetaData.name: Jawa Ion Weapons (local)
ModMetaData.author: mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
Self-contained, industrial-tier Jawa ion armament for this run.
A single signature weapon — the Jawa Ion Blaster — plus its own ion damage type and a custom "ion buildup" stun hediff. Design goals: - CAPTURE-NOT-KILL: the weapon disables, it does not draw blood. No lethal damage. - TIERED BY TARGET: relies on the vanilla stun-resistance gradient — mechanoids/droids are overloaded almost instantly; flesh pawns resist and must be worn down by accumulated ion buildup before they collapse (alive) and can be arrested. - NOT VERY DANGEROUS, REWARDS CUNNING + TERRAIN: low damage, slow warmup, long cooldown, modest range, accuracy falloff — you win by ganging up, using cover and chokes, and stacking stuns, not by out-shooting anyone. - MOSTLY-XML, PLUS ONE SMALL ASSEMBLY: the ion mechanics are our own vanilla-EMP-based defs, but Assemblies/JawaIonWeapons.dll ships a single DamageWorker subclass, JawaIonWeapons.DamageWorker_IonBuildup, wired in as the workerClass of RSW_JawaIon_Damage. It exists so each hit deposits RSW_JawaIon_Stun severity, which vanilla's additionalHediffs cannot do for a non-injury damage type. It is load-bearing: if it fails to load, RSW_JawaIon_Damage cannot resolve its workerClass. It contains no Log calls, so it is SILENT whether it works or not — a clean log is not evidence about it either way. Verify from the def dump instead: RSW_JawaIon_Damage.workerClass must read "JawaIonWeapons.DamageWorker_IonBuildup".
The weapon's own gun art is bundled here (Textures/JawaIon/Weapon_JawaIonBlaster.png). For the fired look and sound it reuses Outer Rim - Core's ion bolt sprite and blaster audio, so Core is a required dependency (Core in turn pulls Vanilla Expanded Framework and Tabula Rasa).
The RSW_JawaIon_Stun hediff doubles as the "stun -> down" mechanic the capture pipeline (CPERS: Arrest Here) needs.
VEHICLE_ION_TIER_1 (2026-08-29): a second assembly, Assemblies/JawaIonVehicleTier.dll, gives the weapon a real effect against Vehicle Framework vehicles — droid-tier EMP amount, scaled LINEARLY by the vehicle's footprint area (an estimate of its volume relative to a droid's own 1x1) rather than the flesh tier's body-size-squared curve. Soft dependency: it self-disables with a log warning if Vehicle Framework is not loaded, same as the base weapon works without it.
